meta.name: lcx-doctor
meta.description: Diagnose LazyCodex and Codex CLI installation health against the latest sources. Use whenever the user asks for a doctor or health check, says LazyCodex, lazycodex-ai, omo-codex, or Codex behaves oddly after an install, update, or config change, suspects a stale, drifted, or broken setup, or wants the local install audited and compared with the latest LazyCodex and Codex code.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 检查并修复 LazyCodex 和 Codex CLI 的安装健康状态
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果本地 LazyCodex 或 Codex 安装可能已过时或损坏
copy.tagline_en: Check and fix LazyCodex and Codex CLI installation health
copy.fit_line_en: For you if your local LazyCodex or Codex install may be stale or broken

howto.what: 装上后，当你要求检查 LazyCodex 或 Codex CLI 的安装状态时，它会将本地安装与最新源码对比，生成通过/警告/失败报告，并给出修复建议。只诊断不修改。
howto.when: 当你提到“医生”“健康检查”“LazyCodex”“omo-codex”等关键词，或感觉 Codex 安装/更新/配置后异常时触发。

say.text: 帮我诊断 LazyCodex 安装是否正常
say.note: 它会运行检查并生成报告。

say.text: 对比我的 Codex 安装和最新版本
say.note: 它会同步最新源码并对比差异。

say.text: 我的 Codex 最近更新后出问题了
say.note: 它会定位配置或文件漂移问题。

howto.what_en: When you ask to check the health of LazyCodex or Codex CLI, it compares the local installation against the latest sources, generates a PASS/WARN/FAIL report with evidence, and proposes fixes. It diagnoses only, never mutates your setup.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you mention 'doctor', 'health check', 'LazyCodex', 'lazycodex-ai', 'omo-codex', or when Codex behaves oddly after install/update/config change, or you suspect a stale/broken setup.

say_en.note: It runs checks and produces a report.

say_en.text: Compare my Codex install with the latest version
say_en.note: It syncs fresh sources and compares drift.

say_en.text: My Codex broke after the last update
say_en.note: It identifies config or payload issues.
